people.name: Hadvar
people.firstMeet: Only if you pick the Dragonborn start (Helgen Keep): in Helgen during Unbound, where you can escape the keep with him. If you go with him, he then waits at his uncle Alvor's house (Alvor and Sigrid's House) in Riverwood. On any other start the records don't place him until Message to Whiterun brings him to the Sleeping Giant Inn, Riverwood.

day.doing: with you during the escape; he holds his place while the opening scene plays
goes about the house, once you've reached Riverwood with him after Helgen
hangs about the inn, once Message to Whiterun is under way

changes: After Helgen he moves into Alvor and Sigrid's House in Riverwood.
From the start of Message to Whiterun he hangs about the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood instead (this package sits above the house one).
On the Imperial side of the civil war he turns up in the field for missions (Compelling Tribute, Rescue from a fort, The Jagged Crown).
people.role: Imperial soldier; your companion out of Helgen if you follow him; a civil war contact on the Legion side

quests.how: a step in it: 'Enter the Keep with Hadvar or Ralof'; you can escape Helgen with him
a step in it: if you escaped with him, he's the friend you talk to in Riverwood ('Hadvar suggested that I head to the nearby town of Riverwood. His uncle is the blacksmith there')
a step in it (Legion side): the field commander sends you; you meet Hadvar, 'Follow' him 'and ambush enemy scout', take over the caravan and 'Report to' him
a step in it (Legion side): the field commander sends you to 'Meet the men near' the fort; he's with them, and you 'Report back to' him at the end
a step in it: Legate Rikke sends you; he's with the Legion party at Korvanjund

unsure.why: Only a class record id is in the extracts; it doesn't resolve to a name, skills or a weapon here, so I can't say how they fight.
Which quest stage moves him into Alvor's house is given only by a quest id the extracts don't name; 'once you reach Riverwood with him' is read from the package's place and Before the Storm's log.
The Riverwood inn package needs only Message to Whiterun's stage 10, so he may hang about the inn even if you never joined the Legion; the records don't add a faction check.
Two more quests from another plugin name him, but their names aren't in the extracts.

That he is the friend in the Legion versions (and Ralof in the Stormcloak ones) is read from the quests' FriendHadvar and FriendRalof aliases; the rule that fills the Friend alias isn't in the extracts.
Where he stands on starts other than Helgen isn't in the extracts: his placed reference sits in the open world with no cell or town.
